name: [🔮UPDATE!] +1 Tongue Escape 😛
desc:
👅 Welcome to +1 Tongue Escape! 👅

HOW TO PLAY:
⚡ Extend your tongue and use it to reach new platforms!
🛝 Slide across your tongue to move through the obstacle course.
💪 Upgrade your tongue and unlock new abilities as you progress.
🏃 Race through challenging stages and avoid falling behind!
🌍 Climb the leaderboards and become the BEST tongue master on the server.
🚀 Keep moving forward, but one wrong move could send you all the way back! 😱

Think you have what it takes to escape?

LIKE the game and join the GROUP for Rewards! 👍
